query: SELECT DATE(createdAt) AS signal_day, type, COUNT(*) AS signal_count, AVG(confidenceScore) AS avg_confidence FROM signals WHERE createdAt >= DATE_SUB(UTC_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(createdAt), type ORDER BY signal_day DESC, type; SELECT id, userId, status, durationDays, minConfidence, maxTradesPerRound, totalRoundsCompleted, totalTradesExecuted, startedAt, lastRunAt, nextRunAt, lastSummary FROM scheduled_simulator_runs ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 5;
